search.method: Per-host seeded simulated annealing with balanced swaps; deterministic best-improvement descent anchored at each host's parent baseline, then deterministic descent from annealing best

parent_four_host_mapping.numa_assignment: sorted ranks within each parent logical host, divided into consecutive groups of 16

optimized_fixed_host_mapping.numa_assignment: independently optimized balanced groups of 16 within each fixed host set

limitations: Eight NUMA groups of 16 ranks per host are a historical-topology assumption, not verified for the current four-node allocation.
The parent candidate host sets are logical membership only; the original physical rank-to-host mapping is not available.
No NUMA page placement, memory locality, process affinity, MPI communication, traffic or solver time was measured.
Graph face counts are proxies, not bytes or hardware cost. No weighted objective combines host and NUMA cuts.
The bounded seeded search with local swap improvement is not a global optimizer and proves no speedup.
